book.subject: english
book.note: 单元目录与语法分布依据2026春版新教材（Unit 1 Past and present ~ Unit 8 A green world）核实；词表、口诀与易错点参考教师整理笔记（小红书/百度文库/21世纪教育网公开资料），建议对照课本 Wordlist 微调。

units.title: Past and present
units.topic_cn: 过去与现在：家乡变迁与现在完成时入门

grammar.name: 现在完成时（一）：基本用法
key_points: 结构：have/has + 过去分词（P.P.）
用法1：过去的动作对现在造成影响——I have just eaten it.
用法2：过去开始持续到现在——We have lived here since 2005.
否定：have/has not + P.P.；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + P.P.?
常见信号词：already, yet, just, ever, never, recently, so far, over the years
examples: Our hometown has changed a lot over the years.
Many people have moved into new flats.
The government has built a new park.

sentence_patterns: There used to be a river in front of our school.
Great changes have taken place in my hometown.
— Have you seen the film yet? — No, not yet.
units.writing_topic: Changes in my hometown（过去→现在对比，至少3句现在完成时）
exam_focus: 不规则过去分词：go→gone, see→seen, be→been, do→done, write→written
already（肯定句）/ yet（否定和疑问句）的位置与选用

tips.text: 现在完成时 = have/has + 过去分词。这学期第一主旋律，先过不规则动词表。
already 用于肯定句，yet 用于疑问/否定句：I have already finished. / I haven't finished yet.
used to do：He used to play football after school. 否定：didn't use to do。
早读背10个不规则动词三态：go-went-gone 开头，每天加10个。
There used to be ... 过去有……：There used to be a small shop here.
not ... any more = no longer：He doesn't live here any more. = He no longer lives here.
睡前自测：be/go/see/do/eat/write/speak/buy/come/give 的过去分词。
家乡变化作文公式：In the past, ... Now, ... has changed a lot. 至少写3组对比。
睡前把 have/has done 读出声5遍，形成『have+过去分词』的肌肉记忆。
since + 过去时间点：since 2005 / since three weeks ago / since then。
完成时口诀：主语加上 have/has，过去分词跟在后；表影响、表持续，标志词来辨清楚。
瞬间动词不能配 for/since：buy→have had，borrow→keep，come→be（here），join→be in。
还有这些标志词：so far、up to now、in the past few years、recently——都配现在完成时。
变迁词例句：He interviewed locals about the changes — the pollution has improved and streets are cleaner.
例句：My grandparents got married in a northern town and have lived there ever since.

units.title: Amazing china
units.topic_cn: 壮美中国：旅行经历与现在完成时深化

key_phrases.en: for + 时间段 / since + 时间点

grammar.name: 现在完成时（二）：have been to / have gone to；for 与 since
key_points: have been to：去过某地（人已回来）——I have been to Beijing twice.
have gone to：去了某地（人不在此处）——He has gone to Shanghai.（他不在）
have been in：已在某地待了多久——I have been in Nanjing for ten years.
for + 时间段：for two hours；since + 时间点/从句：since 2020, since he came here
非延续动词不能与 for/since 连用：buy→have had；come→have been；join→have been in
examples: — Where is Tom? — He has gone to the library.
I have been to Xi'an twice.
We have known each other for ten years.

sentence_patterns: How many times have you been to the Great Wall?
The high-speed railway has made travel much faster.
China has so many amazing places of interest.
units.writing_topic: A trip to remember / An amazing place in China（旅行经历+推荐理由）
exam_focus: been to 与 gone to 的区别——单选最高频考点之一
非延续动词转换：have bought → have had；have come → have been here

tips.text: gone to = 去了没回；been to = 去过已回。He has gone to Beijing 意味着他现在不在。
for 后接时间段（for two days），since 后接时间点（since Monday）。
have bought 不能配 for/since：I have had this bike for two years（不是 have bought）。
早读说旅行：I have been to ... / I have never been to ... 各说2句。
词族：amaze→amazing/amazed（人惊讶用 amazed：I am amazed at the view）。
have been to + 次数：I have been there twice. 对次数提问：How many times...?
睡前判断：①She has gone to Beijing twice. ②She has been to Beijing twice. 哪句对？
旅行作文：去过哪（have been to）→看到什么（scenery/view）→感受（fantastic）→推荐。
睡前读一段现在完成时课文，圈出所有 have/has，读出节奏感。
have been in + 地点 + for：I have been in this school for two years（待了多久）。
旅行词例句：The scenery in southern China is fantastic — I have been there twice by high-speed railway.
例句：Xi'an is full of history and culture — I wonder which place to visit first.

units.title: The world at one click
units.topic_cn: 一键世界：网络生活与两种过去时对比

key_phrases.en: at the click of a button

key_phrases.cn: 过去常常（区分于完成时）

grammar.name: 一般过去时与现在完成时的对比
key_points: 一般过去时：只说过去发生，不涉及现在——I saw the film last week.
现在完成时：强调对现在的影响/持续——I have seen the film.（看过了，不用再看）
过去时带明确的过去时间状语：yesterday, last week, in 2020, two days ago
完成时信号词：already, yet, just, ever, never, so far, recently
对方问『什么时候』就必须切回过去时：— Have you visited it? — Yes, I visited it in 2024.
examples: I have already downloaded the song. I downloaded it last night.
She has never chatted online before.
We learned about the Internet two years ago.

sentence_patterns: The Internet makes our lives easier, but we should use it wisely.
How do you search for information online?
Things have changed a lot since the Internet appeared.
units.writing_topic: The Internet in my life（利与弊各2条，用上两种时态对比）
exam_focus: 看到 yesterday/last.../ago 选过去时；看到 already/yet/so far 选完成时

tips.text: 一句话分清：Did you eat?（问过去那件事）Have you eaten?（问现在饱没饱）。
有 yesterday/ago/last year 就用过去时，别配 have done。
information 不可数：a piece of information，不可以说 informations。
早读说网络习惯：I use ... to search for ... / I have just downloaded ...
答句出现具体时间就要用过去时：—Have you seen it? —Yes, I saw it yesterday.
search for + 目标：search for information on the Internet。
睡前做5道时态二选一：did / have done，标出判断依据（时间状语）。
网络利弊作文：2 advantages（search information, communicate）+ 2 disadvantages（too much screen time），结尾给1条建议。
睡前把今天的两种时态句子各读3句，体会『过去的事』vs『影响现在』。
communicate 名词 communication；click on the link 点击链接。
网络词例句：Click on the website, search for information and download it — communicating online is easy.
例句：The main advantage of the Internet is that information travels faster than ever.

units.title: A good read
units.topic_cn: 阅读之乐：书籍与必须/疑问词+不定式

grammar.name: 疑问词 + to-infinitives；must 与 have to
key_points: 疑问词 what/how/where/when/which + to do：I don't know what to read.
常接疑问词+to do 的动词：know, decide, wonder, ask, learn, forget
must：主观必须（我必须）——I must finish it today.
have to：客观必须（不得不）——I have to stay at home because it rains.
mustn't = 禁止（千万不能）；don't have to = 不必（≠ mustn't！）
must 的否定回答用 needn't / don't have to
examples: Can you tell me how to get to the library?
You mustn't speak loudly in the library.
It's late. I have to go now.

sentence_patterns: The book is full of interesting stories.
I read every day so that I can learn more words.
Reading is a good way to relax.
units.writing_topic: My favourite book / The joy of reading（书名、内容、推荐理由）
exam_focus: mustn't（禁止）与 don't have to（不必）的区别——必考
borrow...from 与 lend...to 方向别搞反

tips.text: mustn't = 禁止；don't have to = 不必。You mustn't litter / You don't have to come early. 意思完全不同。
疑问词+to do：I don't know what to read next. = I don't know what I should read next.
borrow 借入（borrow from），lend 借出（lend to）：Can you lend me your book?
早读前先读2页课外书——用英语开始一天，比刷手机醒脑。
so that + 句子表目的：I take notes so that I can review later.（可与 in order to 互转）
must 是主观『我要做』，have to 是客观『不得不做』——语境判断题常考。
睡前把今天读的内容用3句英语概括，练 summary 能力。
推荐一本书：名字→主要内容→最喜欢的人物→一句推荐语（Don't miss it!）。
睡前固定读10分钟英文读物，比周末补2小时有效得多。
must 引导的一般疑问句否定回答：No, you needn't.（不用 mustn't！）
书词例句：The novel was written by a famous author — this classic is worth reading again.
例句：Borrow books from the library and return them on time — reading is a habit that improves your mind.

units.title: Good manners
units.topic_cn: 文明礼仪：公共场合的规范

key_phrases.en: wait in line / queue for one's turn

grammar.name: enough 与 too 的用法；enough to / too ... to
key_points: adj + enough + to do：He is old enough to go to school.
enough + n：enough time / enough money（enough 在名词前，形容词后）
too + adj + to do = so ... that + 否定句 = not ... enough to do 三句互转
too ... to：The box is too heavy for me to carry. = The box is so heavy that I can't carry it.
for sb 可插入：too tired for him to walk
examples: He is polite enough to wait in line.
The little boy is too young to go to school by himself.
She is not old enough to drive.

sentence_patterns: We should keep quiet in the library.
It's impolite to push in before others.
Good manners make a better world.
units.writing_topic: Good manners at school / in public（列3-4条规范+解释为什么）
exam_focus: too...to 与 so...that、not...enough to 的三句互转——同义句转换必考
enough 的位置：old enough（形后）vs enough time（名前）

tips.text: 三句互转背熟：He is too young to go. = He is so young that he can't go. = He is not old enough to go.
enough 位置口诀：形后名前——old enough ✓ / enough old ✗；enough money ✓ / money enough ✗
polite→impolite（否定前缀 im-）；possible→impossible 同款。
早读说校园礼仪：Queue for your turn. / Don't drop litter. / Say 'please' and 'thank you'.
It's + adj + to do 评价行为：It's impolite to talk with your mouth full.
avoid + doing：Avoid making noise. 不接 to do。
睡前把 too...to 三句互转各默写一遍，这是本单元最值钱的句型。
礼仪作文：总起（Good manners are important.）→4条 do/don't→结尾倡议。
睡前自查：今天有没有排队、有没有说 thank you——礼仪是练出来的。
too...to 里的 too 是『太…以至于不』，自带否定，别再加 not。
礼貌词例句：It's polite to queue for your turn, but impolite to drop litter or push in.
例句：He behaved properly as a guest — he avoided making noise and picked up the litter.

units.title: Sunshine for all
units.topic_cn: 阳光普照：关爱弱势群体与志愿服务

key_phrases.en: It is + adj + (for/of sb) to do

grammar.name: It is + adj + to do / for sb to do / of sb to do
key_points: It is + adj + to do：It is meaningful to be a volunteer.
It is + adj + for sb + to do：形容词修饰事情（important, necessary, difficult）——It is necessary for us to help them.
It is + adj + of sb + to do：形容词修饰人品（kind, kind-hearted, brave, generous, nice）——It is kind of you to donate books.
判断口诀：形容词能形容『人』就用 of，只能形容『事』就用 for
It 作形式主语，真正主语是不定式，避免头重脚轻
examples: It is meaningful to volunteer for the event.
It is difficult for the blind to read normal books.
It was generous of him to donate all his savings.

sentence_patterns: We can volunteer to help children in poor areas.
They have trouble (in) walking, but they never give up.
Helping others makes us happy.
units.writing_topic: Being a volunteer / Helping people in need（做过的志愿事+感受）
exam_focus: for/of 的选择：It is kind of you to help. / It is important for us to help.
have trouble (in) doing 的固定搭配

tips.text: for 还是 of？形容词说人品（kind/brave/generous）用 of；说事情难易重要（important/hard）用 for。
It is meaningful to help others. It 是形式主语，真正的主语是 to help others。
have trouble (in) doing：He has trouble walking. 不用 to do。
早读背关爱词群：disabled, blind, deaf, donate, volunteer, charity。
词形转换高频：donate→donation；mean→meaningful；kind→kindness。
give up 后接 doing：Never give up trying. 不是 to try。
睡前5道 for/of 快速判断，说出判断理由。
志愿作文三步：做了什么（volunteered to...）→遇到什么困难（It was difficult to...）→收获（It is meaningful to...）。
睡前想想明天能不能帮别人做一件小事——单元主题落到行动。
It's + adj + of sb to do 中的 sb 用宾格：It was kind of him（不是 he）to help。
关爱词例句：The disabled need our support — volunteer to donate books or care for the blind.
例句：Joining the charity event is a meaningful chance to show kindness and team spirit.

units.title: Charities
units.topic_cn: 慈善组织与被动语态（一）

grammar.name: 被动语态（一）：一般现在时与一般过去时
key_points: 一般现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词——English is spoken by many people.
一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词——The charity was set up in 1946.
用于不知道/不必说动作执行者，或强调承受者
by + 动作执行者：The school was set up by a kind man.
变被动三步：宾语提前→be 动词随新主语和时态变→动词改过去分词
examples: UNICEF was set up in 1946 to help children.
Millions of children are helped by charities every year.
The patient was treated with a new medicine.

sentence_patterns: It was founded to help children in poor areas.
Money is donated to the charity every year.
Doctors are needed in poor areas, so more volunteers will be sent.
units.writing_topic: A charity I admire（机构、成立时间用被动、宗旨、我的行动）
exam_focus: be 动词选 am/is/are 还是 was/were——看时间状语
set up 的被动：was set up（别丢过去分词）
so...that 与 so that 的区分（结果 vs 目的）

tips.text: 被动语态公式：be + 过去分词。现在时 is/are done，过去时 was/were done。
别忘过去分词！The school was set up in 2000. 不能写 was set up→was setUp/was seting。
变被动口诀：宾变主，be 随时态变，动词变过去分词，原主语放 by 后。
早读把今天的日常事变成被动句：The classroom is cleaned every day. 造3句。
afford 常与 can/can't 连用：can't afford to buy a house。
so that（目的，接句子）vs so...that（结果）：He saved money so that he could... / He was so moved that he cried.
睡前把今天写的5个主动句改成被动句，检查过去分词。
慈善机构作文：It was set up in ... / Children are given food and education by it. 被动句是本单元作文加分点。
睡前再背10个不规则过去分词——被动语态全靠它。
treat（治疗）→treatment；operate（做手术）→operation。
不及物动词没有被动：happen、take place、appear 不用 be done。
动词短语变被动不能丢介词：He was laughed at.（不是 was laughed）look after 同理。
情态动词被动口诀：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。This watch can be repaired in two days。
慈善词例句：The charity was set up to help the poor — doctors treat patients and hand out medicine.
例句：Many patients can't afford treatment, so the charity carries on with free operations.

units.title: A green world
units.topic_cn: 绿色世界：环保生活与被动语态（二）

key_phrases.en: It is time for us to ...

grammar.name: 被动语态（二）：一般将来时
key_points: will be + 过去分词：The show will be held this Friday evening.
be going to be + 过去分词：A lot of activities are going to be organized.
否定：will not (won't) be + 过去分词；疑问：Will + 主语 + be + 过去分词?
主动变被动：We will plant trees. → Trees will be planted (by us).
主语第一人称也可用 shall be + 过去分词
examples: More trees will be planted next spring.
Rubbish is thrown into lakes, so many of them are polluted.
Ways to protect the environment will be discussed at the show.

sentence_patterns: Our environment is changing for the worse.
It is time for us to go green!
If we work together, we can make the world a better place.
units.writing_topic: Going green / How to protect our environment（3条绿色做法，至少1句将来被动）
exam_focus: will be done 与 be going to be done 两种结构
综合运用：一般现在/过去/将来三种被动时态的辨析（期末重点）
主动表被动：The books sell well. / The dish smells good.

tips.text: 将来被动 = will be + 过去分词：More trees will be planted. 不是 will plant。
be going to be done：A lot of activities are going to be held in the town square。
主动表被动：The books sell well（畅销）；The music sounds nice。系动词后不加被动。
早读绿色承诺3句：Plastic bags will be banned. / Rubbish will be separated. / More trees will be planted.
re- 词族：reuse 再利用，recycle 回收，reduce 减少——三个 re 分清。
It is time for us to go green. = It is time that we went green.（高考前的伏笔，了解即可）
期末冲刺：睡前把三种被动（is done / was done / will be done）各默写1句。
环保作文：现状（is polluted）→措施（will be taken / we should）→展望（a greener world will be built）。
期末周：睡前用『回忆法』合上书过一遍本单元知识清单，想不起的标记明天看。
wise→wisely：We should use energy wisely. good 的副词也是 well。
被动三步法：找动作承受者→变主语→调 be 动词时态，最后动词全变过去分词。
by + 执行者，in + 地点：It is made by us. / It is made in China。
环保词例句：Rubbish should be separated and plastic bags reduced — we can reuse things wisely.
例句：Less electricity will be wasted if we turn off the lights — going green saves energy.
